scientific_integrity: All-order theorem has a complete analytic proof. Exact finite Gram checks cross-check rather than replace that proof. Literature originality remains provisional and explicitly credits prior semi-balanced root-polytope theory and oriented-cycle Ehrhart formulas.
scientific_limitations: Proof covers unit-incidence connected simple unicyclic graphs only. Sharp leaf-edge extremum is for one four-cycle pendant-star family. It does not compare quantities of different intrinsic dimensions; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp orientation-dependent Euclidean volume of unicyclic directed-edge polytopes
